concerns.text: T104 requires evaluation_metrics.json to contain 'paired t-test p-values with the SC-003 p<0.01 bias check' AND to conform to evaluation_results.schema.yaml, but the contract's metric_block defines only mae, r2, tost_p_value, ci_lower, ci_upper with additionalProperties:false. A schema-compliant output cannot contain the t-test p-value, so T104's two verification clauses are mutually unsatisfiable as written. Either the contract must gain a t_test_p_value field or T104 must drop schema conformance — as-is the task cannot preserve FR-005/SC-003 and pass its own check.

Spec US-2 Scenario 1 specifies 'a target of 5 epochs (maximum 50 epochs)'; T104 runs 'max 50 epochs' with no target-epoch guidance. Minor parameter drift — record the 5-epoch target (or note early stopping governs) so the task does not silently narrow the spec's training criterion.
